# flowdit

> flowdit is an AI-powered manufacturing operations platform that cuts inspection errors by 80% through intelligent automation, real-time visibility, and compliance management.

flowdit provides comprehensive software solutions for manufacturing, construction, energy, and healthcare sectors. The platform combines AI-driven inspection, workflow automation, IoT monitoring, and compliance management to optimize operations and reduce downtime across connected worker, quality, maintenance, and safety functions.

## Key Topics

- AI-powered inspection
- Manufacturing operations management
- Workflow automation
- IoT monitoring
- Compliance management
- Digital checklists
- Mobile field operations
- Incident reporting
- Maintenance management (CMMS)
- Quality management (EQMS)
- EHS audits
- Connected worker platform
- No-code forms
- Real-time visibility
- Error reduction
